mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_reminders (user_id, pet_id, type, title, cycle_days, next_run_at, note, is_active) VALUES (#{userId}, #{petId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{cycleDays}, #{nextRunAt}, #{note}, #{isActive})
mapper.update:
UPDATE health_reminders
title = #{title}, cycle_days = #{cycleDays}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, last_run_at = #{lastRunAt}, note = #{note}, is_active = #{isActive},
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE health_reminders SET deleted_at = #{now}, is_active = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM health_reminders WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM health_reminders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM health_reminders WHERE is_active = 1 AND next_run_at <= #{now} AND deleted_at IS NULL
